text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening and closing paragraphs","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It states a position early and keeps returning to that claim instead of drifting away from the task."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on cons and pros","quality":"organization","description":"It is structured into introduction, body, and conclusion with separate sections that support the argument."},{"evidence":"“who is at fault-the driver or the manufacturer?” and “initial cost”","quality":"development of reasons","description":"It develops multiple reasons against objections and explains why the benefits outweigh the drawbacks."},{"evidence":"“saving a lot of money,” “less stress with traffic jams,” “entertainment built into the system”","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It uses several relevant details from the article to support claims rather than relying mostly on general statements."},{"evidence":"“Although there are some setbacks… there are many more advantages”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges negative concerns and then answers them, which makes the argument more persuasive."}]}
